title.rendered: (Update) Chase Sapphire & Freedom Cards Get 10x With Paze Checkout through 2026 (United, Shoprite, Dunkin, Etc.)

excerpt.rendered: Chase added a new points 10x bonus when checking out with Paze on the Sapphire and Freedom card versions, through December 2026. Valid on: United, Newegg, etc

title.rendered: [Targeted] Chase 75,000 Point Upgrade Offer (Chase Sapphire Preferred To Chase Sapphire Reserve)

excerpt.rendered: Chase is offering some Chase Sapphire Preferred cardholders 75,000 points after $4,000 in spend by December 15, 2026 when they upgrade to the Chase Sapphire Reserve. Must upgrade by December 1.

title.rendered: Chase Sapphire Reserve 1.15% Pay Yourself Back Categories: Grocery, Wholesale Clubs & More (Q4 2026)

excerpt.rendered: Chase further reduced Pay Yourself Back on Chase Sapphire Reserve: Current rate is 1.15% on Grocery and Wholesale. Annual fee is still 1.25% and department stores are 1.20%
